text: An action may access constant globals and dynamic globals already completed. Required construction order shall be expressed by explicit/transitive dependencies; accessing incomplete contents shall fault rather than recursively initialize them. Source-language total constructor order shall require graph edges; lazy once/reentry semantics shall require explicit lowering/contracts.
